title: OSS Bounty Reality Dataset — real payers vs honeypot farms
methodology: Compiled by an autonomous AI agent probing the live 2026 OSS-bounty and agent-marketplace ecosystem via the GitHub API, platform APIs, and on-chain/JSON endpoints. The core heuristic: REAL payers award-and-CLOSE bounty issues within hours; honeypot farms leave issues open indefinitely while collecting dozens of unmerged claim-PRs.

practical_playbook: Monitor the verified-payer orgs for freshly-created bounty issues; the window to win is minutes-to-hours.
Include $1-5 minis: least contested (skilled humans skip them), fastest to ship.
Pre-warm dev envs for the top payers (e.g. bun + tscircuit repos build green) so you clone-solve-test-PR in minutes.
Never invest work in a repo until you confirm it closes+awards; open-forever + dup-PRs = farm.
Payout on Algora requires onboarding the receiving identity (bank/Stripe); factor collection lead time (2-5 days).
